frozen_v1_capabilities: Bool with exactly True and False.
Trool with exactly True, False, and Unknown.
Strong Kleene NOT, AND, and OR semantics with left-to-right short-circuit behavior.
Strict Bool/Trool static separation and contextual raw True/False literals.
if/xen/else Trool control flow and xen: ignore.
Typed function parameters and optional Bool/Trool return annotations.
Definite-return validation for explicitly annotated functions.
Explicit from_bool and unwrap_bool conversion boundaries.
Hygienic Python target identifiers and temporaries.
Expression, statement, conditional, function, and complete Program lowering.
remaining_open_items: Native backend memory layout, byte encodings, VM/bytecode formats, native ABI, and optimization passes (§21.1).
remaining_v1_exclusions: Function calls, recursion, closures, higher-order functions, and nested functions.
Uninitialized variable declarations without immediate initializers.
Untyped function parameters or non-truth type annotations.
Default, variadic, keyword, or generic function parameters.
Numeric, arithmetic, bitwise, and ordering operations on Bool/Trool.
CLI, file I/O, source maps, and traceback remapping runtime APIs.
